thread:
maya.patel: Heads-up — we need a focused telemetry set for continuous batching tuning. Want dashboards covering batch formation (batch size/hits), queue policies (queue depth, wait time), token budget targets (tokens/sec, tokens/batch), and correlations with kernel selection + KV cache hits/misses. Example goals: spot when p50 queue_time > 20ms, batch_util < 0.6, token/sec drop, or kernel fallback happening.

alex_k: Agree. For dashboards I'd add histograms for batch_size, queue_time buckets, and a stacked area for tokens/sec per model variant.

dan: +1. Also need trace links when batch_util dips — show commit, kernel tag, model version, quantization profile.

infra-bot: Suggested metrics to emit from runtime: `batch_size`, `batch_utilization`, `queue_depth`, `queue_time_ms`, `tokens_emitted`, `tokens_consumed`, `kv_cache_hits`, `kv_cache_misses`, `kernel_selector_decision`, `gpu_occupancy`.

maya.patel: Can we get concrete PromQL and panel ideas? Perf QA wants alertable thresholds.

alex_k: Draft panels:
- Batch size distribution (histogram)
- Live queue depth (gauge)
- Queue time p50/p95/p99 (heatmap)
- Tokens/sec rolling 1m/5m (line)
- Batch utilization (ratio tokens used vs capacity)
- KV cache hit rate (per model+route)
- Kernel selection count by path (bar)

Example PromQL: `rate(runtime_batch_size_bucket[5m])` for histogram, and `avg_over_time(runtime_queue_time_ms[1m])` for latency.

jin: For token budget targets we should compute `tokens_per_batch = tokens_consumed / batch_count` and compare to configured target. Suggest emitting `token_budget_target` per route.

perf-qa: Perf regression correlation idea: when we see a regression alert on tokens/sec, link to flamegraphs and profiling artifacts. Tag metrics with `commit`, `kernel_hash`, `model_version`, `route`.

maya.patel: Alerts: queue_time_p95 > 100ms for 2m -> paging; batch_util < 0.4 for 5m -> ticket; tokens/sec drop >20% vs 30m baseline -> warn.

alex_k: Also add a debug sample stream: when `batch_util < 0.5` and `queue_time_p95 > 50ms`, emit one request trace per minute with KV cache logs + kernel decision. Keep sampling bounded.

dan: Dashboards should allow slicing by dedicated vs hosted vs private deployments — add `deployment_type` tag.

perf-qa: Add lightweight user-facing SLO metric: `inference_latency_p95` and `successful_responses_per_minute` so we don't optimize batching at cost of tail latency.

maya.patel: I'll make a doc with panel queries and alert thresholds. Who can create Grafana panels and instrument the runtime?

alex_k: I can PR a metrics emitter for `kernel_selector_decision` and `batch_utilization`.

jin: I'll add `token_budget_target` telemetry on the orchestration side.

perf-qa: I'll wire alerts and create runbook snippets.

srebot: deploy-bot: grafana/dashboard/continuous-batching updated (draft) — link: https://grafana.internal/r/continuous-batching-draft

maya.patel: Thanks team. Let's sync Thu 10am to review mockups. :white_check_mark: 

alex_k: pinging @darcy for KV cache metrics retention — Darcy?

darcy: On it. We'll keep 30d raw, 90d downsampled for storage budget.

maya.patel: perfect — closing loop.
